title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode5 The Pink-Colored Girl in the Classroom

meta.Episode: Episode5 — The Pink-Colored Girl in the Classroom
meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Where am I...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I remember finding that fragment of a feeling on the rooftop...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But I could've sworn that it flashed before I touched it.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Could it be that it's not the sort of fragment we're used to encountering...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can't say for sure, but I probably should investigate this place a little bit...)
bgm_area00001
A few hours earlier
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Not here either...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm not seeing any either.
I guess it just means there aren't any in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, there has to be some!
This is a school for pity's sake!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, there are quite a few other trees...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: None over on the north side either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I was afraid of that...
We've looked once before too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but we didn't find anything that time either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose that means there just aren't any cherry blossom trees around here...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Noooo!
What kind of school doesn't have any cherry blossom trees?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sorry, but there isn't much we can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But knowing that is a bit disheartening. I was really hoping that we'd be able to find some together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, me too...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's unfortunate that there aren't any cherry blossoms here, but you can still show us the ones around where you live, right...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It is unfortunate, but that seems to be our only option at this point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Why the long faces?
There's no need to look so down...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we can always use your phones to pop over if we ever do want to see some cherry blossoms, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Len, you didn't get a chance to hear what we were talking about before we started searching.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Huh?
What were you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were wondering if there was a way for us to have a picnic under some cherry blossom trees over here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
W-Wait, Ichika...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when Miku said, “Cherry blossoms are just like Luka.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
That's so nice of you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-It just sort of popped into my mind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. But we all agreed with you, didn't we? Even on its own, a cherry blossom tree is a beautiful sight that you can stare at endlessly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, she has a point...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
That explains why you were looking so hard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly.
On top of all that, we wanted to show Luka some actual cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. We thought Luka would look so pretty as she looked up at some cherry blossoms from underneath a tree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, and picturesque.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we can always have a picnic over on our side if it turns out that there aren't any in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: True. They're in bloom right now, so I'm sure you'll enjoy seeing some for yourself, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I was really hoping that we'd find some cherry blossoms here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're still dwelling on that, Saki?
We're still having a picnic together, so cheer up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if you're trying to introduce your favorite band to someone you really care about, you'd want to go see them at a live house together, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not the best example...
But I get your point...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See? That's why I want us to see some together in the “same SEKAI”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But wishing won't make any cherry blossoms sprout from the ground, so why don't we have a spring-like session instead...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun! Nice idea, Sakki☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I like it too!
Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
Everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we should probably head back soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll let you know when we find a good day to have our picnic!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks!
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'll be waiting♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Cherry blossoms, huh...?
I never really gave them much thought until now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See? That's why I want us to see some together in the “same SEKAI”...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I want to support those girls and their feelings as much as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (So I'll keep looking.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still nothing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even around the gate and behind the school, I'm not seeing any such trees. That just leaves...
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I should be able to see pretty far from here. Maybe, just maybe, I'll be able to find something...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But this SEKAI just seems to be devoid of them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I really wanted to make Saki and the others smile, but I think I'm out of leads...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
A fragment of a feeling...?
*Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (This field seems endless...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That tree's the only prominent feature...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It looks like cherry blossom petals are falling from it, but I don't think those are actual cherry blossoms...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But if that was really a fragment of a feeling, then this must be a brand-new SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Let's go take a closer look...)
